summary: Feed s072_single to SIEM is degraded: required VLAN 20 not seen, 51% of packets arrive untagged, breaking VLAN-aware detection for SIEM.

findings.root_cause: Upstream TAP/SPAN or packet broker is stripping 802.1Q tags or delivering via an access/untagged port or trunk not carrying VLAN 20. Broker VLAN filtering/policy is dropping VLAN 20 tags before delivery, leaving 51% of traffic untagged.
findings.impact_on_tool: SIEM requires VLANs 10 and 20 for correlation and filtering. With VLAN 20 absent and 51% untagged, SIEM cannot attribute traffic to correct tenant/segment, VLAN-based rules and detection coverage for VLAN 20 fails.

recommended_fix.why: Preserving 802.1Q tags for VLANs 10 and 20 through the packet broker ensures SIEM receives correctly tagged traffic and can apply VLAN-aware correlation and detection.
